plan-1ifnj4v.title: The Ultimate PULL Workout For Muscle Growth (Back, Biceps, Rear Delts)
plan-1ifnj4v.description: Jeff Nippard 终极拉系高颗粒度计划：包含背阔肌、上背部、后束与二头长短头

source.title: The Ultimate PULL Workout For Muscle Growth [Back, Biceps, Rear Delts] (2023)

exercises.name_zh: 高位下拉 (包含 4 组递进喂重组)
exercises.notes: 4 feeder sets build lat mind-muscle connection and prime neural drive before final failure set.
coaching_cues: Drive down with your elbows rather than pulling with your hands to isolate lats.
Maintain a slight 15-degree chest tilt and avoid excessive lower back arching.
Control the eccentric phase for 2-3 seconds to stretch the lat insertion.

evidence.text: 01:33 - Lat pulldown setup and feeder set progression demonstration.

exercises.name_zh: 全握姿胸部支撑机器划船 (多角度抓握)
exercises.target_muscle_zh: 上背部、菱形肌与斜方肌中下束
exercises.notes: Rotate grip width and elbow angle across sets to target upper back thickness vs lat width.
coaching_cues: Use neutral grip for lat-focused rows, and overhand wider grip for rhomboid focus.
Keep chest firmly glued to the pad to completely eliminate lower back momentum.
Squeeze scapulae together at peak contraction for a full 1-second pause.

evidence.text: 05:07 - Omni-grip chest supported machine row grip angle breakdown.

exercises.source_name: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown / Cable Pullover
exercises.name_zh: 中立握姿下拉 / 绳索直臂拉开
exercises.target_muscle_zh: 背阔肌髂骨部 (下背阔部分)
exercises.notes: Targeting the lower iliac fibers of the lats in the fully extended overhead stretch.
coaching_cues: Pull hands down towards hips while keeping arms slightly bent.
Focus on dragging elbows down to waist level to engage lower lat origin.
Pause at peak stretch overhead without shrugging shoulders.

evidence.text: 07:30 - Neutral grip lat pullover setup for lower lat activation.

exercises.source_name: Reverse Pec Deck / Cable Rear Delt Flye
exercises.name_zh: 反向蝴蝶机后束飞鸟 (三角肌后束孤立)
exercises.notes: Isolating the posterior deltoid with high reps and controlled tempo.
coaching_cues: Abduct arms in a slight 45-degree angle rather than pure horizontal to align with rear delt fibers.
Keep scapulae neutral and avoid squeezing shoulder blades together excessively.
Use light weight and push to near failure.

evidence.text: 08:40 - Reverse pec deck flye focusing purely on rear delt isolation.

exercises.name_zh: 上斜哑铃二头弯举 (长头位伸展受力)
exercises.notes: Positioning shoulders behind torso stretches the long head of the bicep for maximal hypertrophy.
coaching_cues: Set bench to 45-60 degrees and allow arms to hang fully vertically behind torso.
Supinate wrists strongly at the top of the movement.
Keep upper arms stationary; do not swing elbows forward.

evidence.text: 09:40 - Incline dumbbell curl to stretch long head of biceps behind torso.

plan-1g0ij5s.title: The Ultimate PUSH Workout For Muscle Growth (Chest, Shoulders, Triceps)
plan-1g0ij5s.description: Jeff Nippard 终极推系高颗粒度计划：包含上胸、中胸、肩部前中束与三头长短头

source.title: The Ultimate Science-Based Leg Day For Muscle Growth (2023)

exercises.name_zh: 上斜哑铃卧推 (上胸发力)
exercises.notes: Set bench incline to 30 degrees to optimize upper chest fiber alignment.
coaching_cues: Retract and depress shoulder blades into bench before un-racking.
Lower dumbbells under control until reaching a deep stretch at bottom.
Press in a smooth arc without locking out elbows aggressively at top.

evidence.text: 01:15 - Incline dumbbell press setup with 30 degree incline for clavicular head.

exercises.name_zh: 站姿杠铃推举 (肩部整体推举)
exercises.target_muscle_zh: 三角肌前束与核心支撑
exercises.notes: Brace core with deep abdominal pressure to build vertical pushing power.
coaching_cues: Squeeze glutes and brace abs to protect lumbar spine.
Keep bar path vertical close to nose; push head forward slightly at top lockout.
Lower bar under control down to upper collarbone.

evidence.text: 04:10 - Standing OHP for anterior deltoid strength and vertical force development.

exercises.name_zh: 绳索侧平举 (跨体长肌拉伸位)
exercises.notes: Cross-body cable setup ensures continuous high tension at bottom lengthened position.
coaching_cues: Set pulley height between wrist and knee level.
Lead movement with elbows in a slight 30-degree scaption plane forward.
Avoid shrugging upper traps at the top.

evidence.text: 07:15 - Cable lateral raises for side delt hypertrophy.

exercises.name_zh: 哑铃飞鸟 / 绳索夹胸 (胸肌长拉伸位)
exercises.target_muscle_zh: 胸大肌中下束 (胸肌内侧/拉伸位)
exercises.notes: Maximizing horizontal adduction with deep stretch across chest pectoralis major.
coaching_cues: Maintain a soft bend in elbows throughout movement.
Focus on bringing bicep to bicep across chest at top.
Lower smoothly to feel deep stretch across sternum.

evidence.text: 09:00 - Chest flye setup for maximal chest stretch in lengthened position.

exercises.name_zh: 过顶绳索三头臂屈伸 (长头拉伸)
exercises.notes: Overhead arm position places tricep long head under high stretch.
coaching_cues: Lean forward slightly and lock elbows in position beside head.
Achieve deep elbow flexion at bottom without moving upper arms.
Spread rope handles apart at full extension.

evidence.text: 10:10 - Overhead rope extension for triceps long head stretch.

plan-m30uq4c.description: Jeff Nippard 终极拉系高颗粒度计划：包含背阔肌、上背部、后束与二头长短头

source.title: The Ultimate PULL Workout For Muscle Growth [Back, Biceps, Rear Delts] (2023)

exercises.name_zh: 高位下拉 (包含 4 组递进喂重组)
exercises.notes: 4 feeder sets build lat mind-muscle connection and prime neural drive before final failure set.
coaching_cues: Drive down with your elbows rather than pulling with your hands to isolate lats.
Maintain a slight 15-degree chest tilt and avoid excessive lower back arching.
Control the eccentric phase for 2-3 seconds to stretch the lat insertion.

evidence.text: 01:33 - Lat pulldown setup and feeder set progression demonstration.

exercises.name_zh: 全握姿胸部支撑机器划船 (多角度抓握)
exercises.target_muscle_zh: 上背部、菱形肌与斜方肌中下束
exercises.notes: Rotate grip width and elbow angle across sets to target upper back thickness vs lat width.
coaching_cues: Use neutral grip for lat-focused rows, and overhand wider grip for rhomboid focus.
Keep chest firmly glued to the pad to completely eliminate lower back momentum.
Squeeze scapulae together at peak contraction for a full 1-second pause.

evidence.text: 05:07 - Omni-grip chest supported machine row grip angle breakdown.

exercises.source_name: Neutral Grip Lat Pulldown / Cable Pullover
exercises.name_zh: 中立握姿下拉 / 绳索直臂拉开
exercises.target_muscle_zh: 背阔肌髂骨部 (下背阔部分)
exercises.notes: Targeting the lower iliac fibers of the lats in the fully extended overhead stretch.
coaching_cues: Pull hands down towards hips while keeping arms slightly bent.
Focus on dragging elbows down to waist level to engage lower lat origin.
Pause at peak stretch overhead without shrugging shoulders.

evidence.text: 07:30 - Neutral grip lat pullover setup for lower lat activation.

exercises.source_name: Reverse Pec Deck / Cable Rear Delt Flye
exercises.name_zh: 反向蝴蝶机后束飞鸟 (三角肌后束孤立)
exercises.notes: Isolating the posterior deltoid with high reps and controlled tempo.
coaching_cues: Abduct arms in a slight 45-degree angle rather than pure horizontal to align with rear delt fibers.
Keep scapulae neutral and avoid squeezing shoulder blades together excessively.
Use light weight and push to near failure.

evidence.text: 08:40 - Reverse pec deck flye focusing purely on rear delt isolation.

exercises.name_zh: 上斜哑铃二头弯举 (长头位伸展受力)
exercises.notes: Positioning shoulders behind torso stretches the long head of the bicep for maximal hypertrophy.
coaching_cues: Set bench to 45-60 degrees and allow arms to hang fully vertically behind torso.
Supinate wrists strongly at the top of the movement.
Keep upper arms stationary; do not swing elbows forward.

evidence.text: 09:40 - Incline dumbbell curl to stretch long head of biceps behind torso.
